sonnet.problem: The card says "This is another James, the one Peter wants to hear the news, because Herod already put James the brother of John to death." Acts 12:17 doesn't say which James Peter means, so "another James" isn't stated by the text. The text also gives no reason Peter wants this James to hear the news. The card adds both a connection and a reason.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect. / Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why. / He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse.

sonnet.problem: The right answer, "John also called Mark", is given away by stop 2 card 1, which says "Mary, the mother of John, also called Mark." A baker can answer from that card without reasoning anything out.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question "What do they shout his voice is?" is not correct English. It reads awkwardly and is unclear.
sonnet.rule: Clear English. Every card reads correctly. Each answer fits its question.
